text:
Riley: Quick thread — planning a compact newsletter + webinar push for 'Inference Playbook' next Thursday. Main asks: final subject, RSVP gating, segmentation rules, and who owns post-webinar nurture.
Asha: Cohorts: trial-30d, newsletter-active (opens 30d), docs-downloaders (high intent). Add a small "product-eval" tag for folks who've clicked benchmark PDF.
Ben: For docs-downloaders / product-eval we should bypass subject A/B and send a personalized line with company name + 'book a demo' CTA in confirmation.
Marta: RSVP form fields: name, email, company, role, company_size, interest = (benchmark|cost|ops), demo_yes_no. Hidden fields: utm_campaign=inference_playbook_apr, utm_source=email, cohort={cohort}.
Kai: Routing rule (pseudo):
```
if (company_size >= 500 || role =~ /(Head|Director|CTO|PM|ML)/ || cohort == "product-eval") {
  owner = "sdr-enterprise"
} else if (cohort == "trial-30d") {
  owner = "sdr-trial"
} else {
  owner = "sdr-nurture"
}
```
Riley: Suppress: anyone who RSVP'd or attended in last 60d, unsubscribed, hard bounces. Also suppress anyone who opened a benchmark email in past 7d to avoid fatigue. Dedupe so highest-intent cohort wins.
Asha: Send windows: NA/EU = Thu 9AM PT, APAC = Thu 9AM SGT (staggered send). We'll localize the time mention for APAC copy.
Ben: Subject tests: A) "Inference Playbook: benchmark + ops walkthrough" B) "See how teams reduce inference cost in production" — run 10% A/B on newsletter-active only; trials get B only to maximize clarity. Test emoji vs no-emoji on a small slice.
Marta: Preheader: "Thu 9AM PT — 25min demo + live Q&A" or "Latency, cost, and ops tradeoffs, live". Keep under 80 chars.
Kai: Confirmation flow: RSVP -> thank-you modal with calendar add + conditional "Book demo" when owner==sdr-enterprise or demo_yes_no==true. Pass lead_score=high for product-eval. Include a 1-question poll: "primary reason for attending" -> informs follow-up playbooks.
forms-bot: Deploy note: webhook to CRM staging scheduled Wed 18:30 PT. Will map utm_campaign, cohort, role, company_size, and lead_score. Please QA.
Riley: Post-webinar nurture: attendees -> content track (bench notes, how-to, ops checklist); no-shows who RSVP'd -> recording + short surfacing CTA to book; product-eval non-RSVP -> immediate SDR outreach within 48h.
Asha: For routing, confirm pattern matches for roles (PM, ML, Eng, Head, Director). Also include a fallback owner = sdr-nurture to avoid orphan leads.
Ben: Creative notes: hero snapshot of benchmark chart, 3 bullets (latency, cost/token, batching wins), speaker blurbs, RSVP CTA. Keep copy scannable.
Marta: I'll drop final copy + 3 subject variants in #copy-review in 90m and include the APAC-localized line.
Kai: I'll export segments and flag timezone buckets; will place CSV in /marketing/seg-exports/inference-playbook by EOD.
Riley: Owners: Marta (copy + creatives), Kai (segments & routing), Asha (cohort priority + suppressions), Ben (subject tests + personalization), forms-bot (webhook deploy). 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT. Ping here when staging pass is green. :white_check_mark:
